delete.description: Cascades to dataset, versions, items and runs; S3 objects are removed best-effort first.

post.description:
Snapshot the draft current pool membership into a new immutable version (built asynchronously).

With `augmentation`, the build also materializes augmented copies of the TRAIN split (see
services/augmentation.py); validation and test stay original so metrics measure real data.

get.description: The augmentations a snapshot of this project can be built with (installed op classes that support its task).

Paginated pool items for the draft (default) or a given version.

`origin` narrows a snapshot to its real items or to its augmented copies (the draft has no copies).

post.description: Add inline (text/tabular) items to the pool and draft, each with a split assignment.
Upload files (vision/audio) into the pool and draft with one split (and optionally one class).

patch.description: Bulk-reassign the draft split of pool items.

post.description: Bulk-assign a label class: creates or updates each item classification annotation.
Randomly reassign every draft item split by ratio (stratified by class for classification tasks).

get.description: Health / EDA report for the draft: what training would actually see.

patch.description: Re-label in place (avoids delete-then-create). Only the fields that were sent are changed.

delete.description: Soft revoke: keeps the audit trail of what a (possibly leaked) key was.

get.description:
Every installed trainer backend, whether or not it is currently available (e.g. a missing
optional dependency) — for a global settings/diagnostics view, not task-scoped model choice.

Backends that can train this project's task, with their models and hyperparameters — what
the create-run / create-sweep panel renders. Only available backends are included.

delete.description: Delete a run whatever its status. An in-flight run is stopped first.

get.description: Short-poll fallback for the live console.
Paginated misclassified rows from the report, joined back to their pool items.

post.description: One CSV row per prediction, scored in a single Ludwig predict call.
Preload the run model into the cache before the user first request (fire and forget).

get.description:
Installed export formats, grouped and ordered for display.

With `runId`, only the formats that support that run's project task AND whose artifact the
run's own trainer backend can actually produce.

post.description:
Dispatch and wait for the result.

A real await rather than a poll loop. asyncio.shield keeps the job running when the wait
times out or the client disconnects: on timeout the caller gets the same 202 + inferenceId as
before and can poll, and a disconnect can never kill a GPU job another poller may be watching.

202.description: Not finished in time: poll the returned inferenceId

AugmentationConfig.title: AugmentationConfig
AugmentationConfig.description: How to augment the TRAIN split of a snapshot: N extra copies per original, each through these ops.

EvaluationBrief.title: EvaluationBrief
EvaluationBrief.description: Denormalized accuracy / macro-F1, so lists and comparisons need no per-run round trip.

ItemIn.title: ItemIn
ItemIn.description:
No storage_url here on purpose: this route only creates items from inline data (text/tabular).

Accepting a client-chosen S3 key would let one tenant point an item at another tenant pool
object. The only path that writes storage_url is the upload route, which derives the key
server-side from the content hash.

ParamSpec.title: ParamSpec
ParamSpec.description:
One tunable parameter of a plugin (an augmentation op, a trainer backend's hyperparameter,
...), flattened so the web can render a form without knowing the plugin. See `theseus.params`.

PolledJob.title: PolledJob
PolledJob.description:
pending | success (with output) | batch (with rowCount) | failed (with error).

Fields that do not apply to a state are omitted from the response (exclude_none), which is
the same discriminated shape the gateway returned.

UploadResult.title: UploadResult
UploadResult.description: One file outcome, in the same {status, value | reason} shape the gateway returned.
